description: Hua Tuo, gentle old chinese physician in the supplied pixel art style. White hair in a bun, a long pale robe with green trim, a brown medicine satchel on a strap across the body. He holds a short wooden walking staff in the right hand
face: A kind old face with a very long white beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the white hair bun, the pale robe, the satchel strap across the back and the satchel at his hip, the staff at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts what it holds up beside the right shoulder, the left hand lowers, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Calm ready stance holding the wooden staff up, breathing
actions.move: Brisk walk in place with small steps, robe swaying, wooden staff held up, seamless loop. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a2: Open-palm push. The wooden staff stays at his right side. Frames 3-6 the empty LEFT hand draws back; frames 7-8 the left shoulder turns forward, body side-on, and the open left palm pushes straight out; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The wooden staff stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Downward stroke. Frames 3-6 he stands tall and raises the wooden staff above the head; frames 7-8 he drops into a deep knee bend and draws it straight down in front; frames 9-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The wooden staff stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Two-handed push. Frames 3-6 both hands gather in front of the chest; frame 7 the left foot steps forward; frame 8 both hands push straight out together; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The wooden staff stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s3: Open-armed blessing. Frames 3-6 both hands gather low in front of the chest and he bows; frame 8 he rises and spreads both arms wide and up to the sides; frames 9-12 hold. Feet stay in place. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The wooden staff stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a2 → b2 → b3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 지팡이는 손 위쪽만 뼈대에 넣었다.
